data.title: A claim belongs to a claimant, not to the git email: KADENCE_ACTOR, else email#worktree for an agent in a linked worktree
data.why: The git email authors every event and is shared by every agent one person runs, so ten agents were one claimant and all took KAD-1 with nothing to surface at merge (stress audit B1). Authorship stays the email; only data.by changes, which the fold already reads, so FlowEvent keeps its shape. The worktree default fixes the commonest parallel setup with no configuration. A person's prime and ready count their agents' claims as theirs; an agent counts only its own.
data.rejected: Only an explicit KADENCE_ACTOR: nothing changes unless configured, so the worktree collision stays the default; Replace the event actor with the agent name: breaks authorship, which is the git identity everywhere else
